name: life-dashboard
description: Personal life dashboard: tasks, pomodoro, and expense tracker (MERN + Tailwind)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
